blocks.prompt: 9. Show by the trapezium rule that the approximate area bounded by the curve \(y = \sqrt{8 - 2x - x^{2}}\) and the \(x\)-axis using \(n = 8\) is 13.5 square units. Calculate the exact area by using the formula for finding the area of semi-circle.
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qisam ka sawal hai: definite integral ki value Trapezium Rule se approximately nikalni hai, seedha integration nahi karna.
Diya kya hai? Function \(f(x) = \sqrt{8 - 2x - x^{2}}\), interval sawal mein nahi diya; woh curve aur x-axis ke milne ke points se nikalna hai, aur \(n = 8\) diya hai, to \(h = \frac{b-a}{n}\) nikalega.
Find kya karna hai? Approximate area (13.5 tak pohanchna hai) aur phir semicircle ke formula se exact area.
Rule kaunsa aur kyun? Trapezium Rule, kyunke sawal yahi maangta hai: area ko barabar chaurai ki pattiyon (trapeziums) mein baant kar jama karna.
Plan: h ya n, phir points ki list, phir har point par function ki value, phir beech wali values ka jama, aur aakhir mein formula aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sqrt{8 - 2x - x^{2}}\), \(a = -4\), \(b = 2\), \(n = 8\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{-4}^{2} \sqrt{8 - 2x - x^{2}}\,dx\) ki approximate value.
Tareeqa: sawal khud Trapezium Rule maang raha hai, is liye wohi lagayenge. Yahan n diya hai, lekin interval nahi diya; is liye pehle curve se interval nikalenge, phir h. Phir points aur un par function ki values (chaar decimal tak) nikal kar formula \(\frac{h}{2}[\text{pehli} + 2(\text{beech wali}) + \text{aakhri}]\) mein rakhenge.

Region ki limits nikalein
\[8 - 2x - x^{2} = 9 - (x + 1)^{2}\]
\[y = \sqrt{9 - (x+1)^{2}}\]
\[\Rightarrow (x+1)^{2} + y^{2} = 9,\ y \ge 0\]
\[y = 0 \Rightarrow x + 1 = \pm 3 \Rightarrow x = -4, 2\]
Kyun: sawal ne interval nahi diya, is liye pehle dekhte hain ke curve \(x\)-axis ko kahan chhoota hai. Complete square karne se pata chalta hai ke yeh curve us circle ka upar wala aadha hissa (semicircle) hai jis ka centre \((-1, 0)\) aur radius 3 hai. Yeh \(x = -4\) aur \(x = 2\) par axis ko chhoota hai, is liye area \([-4, 2]\) par hai; is interval ke bahar \(8 - 2x - x^{2} < 0\) hai aur curve mojood hi nahi.

Continuity
\([-4, 2]\) par \(8 - 2x - x^{2} \ge 0\) hai (upar wala step dekhiye), aur continuous non-negative function ka square root bhi continuous hota hai, is liye \(y\) poore \([-4, 2]\) par continuous hai.
Kyun: Trapezium Rule continuous function ke liye bana hai; agar graph beech mein toot jaye to trapeziums us hisse ko sahi nahi dhaanp sakte.

Step size aur points
\[h = \dfrac{b-a}{n} = \dfrac{2-(-4)}{8} = \dfrac{6}{8} = 0.75\]
Points \(x_{i} = a + ih\): \(-4, -3.25, -2.5, -1.75, -1, -0.25, 0.5, 1.25, 2\)
Kyun: interval ko 8 barabar hisson mein baanta, to har hisse ki chaurai \(h\) hai. 8 subintervals ke 9 points bante hain: pehla point \(a\) aur aakhri \(b\), baqi beech wale.

Function values (4 decimal places)
\[f(-4) = 0.0000\]
\[f(-3.25) = 1.9843\]
\[f(-2.5) = 2.5981\]
\[f(-1.75) = 2.9047\]
\[f(-1) = 3.0000\]
\[f(-0.25) = 2.9047\]
\[f(0.5) = 2.5981\]
\[f(1.25) = 1.9843\]
\[f(2) = 0.0000\]
Kyun: har point ko function mein rakha. Pehle andar wali qeemat \(8 - 2x - x^{2}\) nikalein, phir square root. Misaal: \(x = -3.25\) par \(8 + 6.5 - 10.5625 = 3.9375\) aur \(\sqrt{3.9375} = 1.9843\).
Dhyan dein: values \(x = -1\) (circle ka centre) ke donon taraf barabar aati hain; yeh ek achhi tasdeeq hai.
Neeche jawab ke saath di gayi table mein yahi values un ke weights (1 ya 2) ke saath hain.

Beech wali values jama karein
\[S = f(x_{1}) + \dots + f(x_{7})\]
\[= 1.9843 + 2.5981 + 2.9047\]
\[+ 3.0000 + 2.9047 + 2.5981\]
\[+ 1.9843\]
\[= 17.9742\]
Kyun: yeh 7 beech wali values har ek do saath wale trapeziums ki saanjhi deewar hain, is liye formula mein in ka jama do dafa (double) aayega. Pehle in ka jama alag nikal lena hisaab ko saaf aur check karne ke qabil banata hai.

Trapezium Rule apply karein
\[\text{Area} \approx \dfrac{h}{2}\big[f(x_{0}) + 2S + f(x_{8})\big]\]
\[= 0.375\big[0.0000 + 2(17.9742)\]
\[+ 0.0000\big]\]
\[= 0.375(35.9484)\]
\[= 13.48065 \approx 13.4807\]
Kyun: \(\frac{h}{2} = 0.375\). Kinaron wali do values ek ek dafa aayin aur beech wali values ka jama do dafa; phir poore bracket ko \(\frac{h}{2}\) se zarb diya. Round sirf aakhri jawab ko kiya, beech mein nahi, taake ghalti jama na ho.

Tasdeeq:
\[\text{Exact area} = \dfrac{1}{2}\pi r^{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}\pi (3)^{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{9\pi}{2} \approx 14.137\]
Kyun: region radius 3 wala semicircle hai, aur poore circle ka area \(\pi r^{2}\) hota hai, to aadhe ka \(\frac{1}{2}\pi r^{2}\). Trapezium wala jawab 13.48 kam hai, kyunke circle ka kinara neeche ki taraf mudta hai aur seedhi chhatein us gol kinare ka thora hissa kaat deti hain, khaas taur par dono siron par jahan curve khara (steep) hai.
blocks.final_answer: Approximate area \(\approx 13.4807 \approx 13.5\) square units (13.48 round ho kar 13.5 hai, jaisa sawal mein hai); exact area \(\frac{9\pi}{2} \approx 14.137\) square units.
